_why: A walk sheet's facing cannot be measured: a silhouette compared against the last reviewed sheet called 2 broken sheets OK and 3 correct ones SWAPPED (2026-11-01, margins within 0.05). So a HUMAN looks, at a committed 4-direction strip, and this row pins what they looked at: the sheet's sha256. Redrawing a sheet reds test_a_walk_sheet_faces_where_it_walks until someone re-renders the strip (tools/render_facing_strips.py), looks at it, and updates the row with what they checked.
